lean.quote: Price could not close above the daily 200 or 20 SMA though, so still a counter trend rally in the context of a developed downtrend.
lean.note: 'If we rally first, I am more open to a look above and fail on the 200 SMA and 662.5 as a short than a breakout buy.' Follow-through-day criteria given as the bull hedge.

calls.quote: 653 is the line in the sand. Above it, mildly neutral. Below it, thin structure opens to 642.85 and back to the bears.
Lose 653 and the setup reverts to bearish breakdown, targeting 642.85 and then equal lows.
First thought on rallies to 662.5 is look above and fail there as a short.
A weekly close back above 675 changes my tone or a higher low after a rally attempt. Until then, this is a lower high attempt.
